correctness.rationale: The Minkowski support function is sum_v |u_v|+sum_edges |u_v-u_w|. Sign decomposition and layer-cake/coarea plus Minkowski inequality show the Euclidean support quotient minimum is an indicator cut (|S|+|delta S|)/sqrt|S|. Equality and exposed-face direction ranks restrict facets to connected S; the corresponding inequalities give the entire incenter locus. For trees, proper connected cuts cost at least k+1, minimizing at a leaf (ratio 2) versus full V (sqrt n); for cycles cost at least k+2, minimizing at adjacent pairs (2sqrt2) versus full V. Contact indicator ranks prove all center dimension regimes, and odd interval length k=3 sharply bounds the even-cycle alternating segment at |t|<=5-2sqrt6. Independent exhaustive all-subset cut minima and contact ranks checked paths, stars and cycles through order 12; read actual verify.py; finite checks not all-order proof.
